meta.title: FIFTY-FIVE — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Tracker
meta.note: All 55 trophies are offline single-player. There is no mission replay, no New Game+, and cheats disable trophies and saving while active, so keep a clean manual save at the start and end of every chapter.

disputes.topic: How long does the platinum take?
disputes.sideA: About 200 hours — PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 and puts it at roughly 200 hours, echoed by KeenGamer and GTASpotter [1][3][5].
disputes.sideB: 300 hours or more — Push Square says to set aside up to 300 hours or more for the platinum [2].
disputes.take: Budget 200 hours if you follow the checklist efficiently; 300 if you explore at leisure. Both agree it is a long grind, not a hard one.

disputes.topic: How many meditation spots are there?
disputes.sideA: 18 spots in total — the trophy asks you to meditate at all 18 required spots across Leonida [3].
disputes.sideB: Only 15 count for 100% completion — KeenGamer's 100% table lists meditations as 15 of 18 for the checklist, with all 18 needed for the separate trophy [3].
disputes.take: Do all 18. The checklist stops at 15, but the trophy does not.

disputes.topic: How many shooting ranges hold the 42 gold medals?
disputes.sideA: 12 ranges — GameTrek lists the 42 Shooting Range challenges as spread across 12 ranges [6].
disputes.sideB: Fewer, larger ranges — other lists describe the 42 challenges without splitting them across 12 named ranges, and some early lists implied only a couple of range locations [4].
disputes.take: Chase the 42 gold medals, not a range count. The medal total is what the trophy checks.

disputes.topic: Which chapter does each story trophy close?
disputes.sideA: Paradise Lost closes Chapter 1 and the next trophies close Chapters 2, 3 and 4 in order [3].
disputes.sideB: GameTrek labels Paradise Lost as completing Chapter 2, shifting the numbering by one [6].
disputes.take: Chapter numbering differs between guides. Follow the mission flow in order, not the chapter numbers.

disputes.topic: Can every Stranger strand be finished after the story?
disputes.sideA: Yes — GTASpotter's roadmap says every quest giver tied to a trophy comes back once the story is over [5].
disputes.sideB: Not freely — some strands are locked to one of the two protagonists, so you must play as the right character [5].
disputes.take: Post-story cleanup works, but switch characters. Do not assume one character can finish every strand.

roadmap.title: Story + side missions
roadmap.text: Play the five chapters, take optional missions as they appear, and scan vehicles and study animals as you go. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia before leaving Chapter 1 — it is the one potentially missable interaction. Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter; there is no mission replay [1][3].

roadmap.title: 100% Completion checklist + challenges
roadmap.text: After the credits, Progress > Stats gains the 100% Completion entry. The checklist is lenient — closer to 60% true completion — but it demands every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest, plus 70 of the 80 challenges [1][3].

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks + cleanup
roadmap.text: Finish the eight qualifying Stranger strands and the character questlines, mop up the remaining meditations, combat, driving and robbery trophies, and the platinum pops [1][3].

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies first; this one pops automatically the moment the last of them unlocks [3].
There is no separate task for it — it is the reward for finishing everything else on this list [7].
Use the Tracker tab to see which grades are still open, and work the roadmap stages in order [1].
If one trophy is left, check the Missables tab first — the only reported missable is the Chapter 1 meditation [1].
Play the opening mission Gone Fishing; it unlocks as part of the story [2].
Follow the mission markers until the mission completes — no side objective is needed [3].
It cannot be missed: every playthrough starts here [3].
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen [2].
Finish every story mission in Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the chapter closes [3].
Before leaving Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house — see Positive Mental Attitude [1].
Some guides number the chapters differently; follow the mission flow, not the chapter number [6].
Keep a manual save at the end of Chapter 1 in case you missed the meditation [3].
Play through Chapter 2 to its finale; the trophy unlocks with the chapter [3].
The final meditation spot only becomes available once you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 [5].
Take optional missions as they appear — they feed the 100% checklist later [1].
Save manually at the start and end of the chapter; there is no mission replay [1].
Finish Chapter 3's story missions in order; the trophy pops at the chapter close [3].
Keep scanning new vehicles with the WAiNK app as you travel — the checklist later needs 200 of 277 base models [1].
Study new animals through the binoculars when you spot them; 100 of 255 species count toward 100% [1].
No extra objective is required beyond the story itself [2].
Complete Chapter 4 to its finale; the trophy unlocks with the chapter [3].
The eight large bank vaults only unlock during Chapter 4, through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… [3].
Start the bank-vault robberies once that mission opens them up [3].
Keep a manual save at the chapter boundaries [3].

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.t: Finish the final story mission; this gold trophy pops at the ending [2].
After the credits you return to free-roam and can keep exploring Leonida as long as you like [2].
Finishing the story unlocks the 100% Completion Checklist under Progress > Stats [1].
Everything you did before the ending already counts toward that checklist [1].
Play the story mission Breakfast Run to completion [3].
It unlocks automatically as part of the story — no side objective needed [2].
Follow the mission markers; failing and retrying a story mission does not block the trophy [1].
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen [3].
Play the story mission The Cartel Heist to completion [3].
It is a story mission, so it unlocks in the normal flow of the campaign [2].
Stock up on armour and ammo before the heist starts, as you would for any big story job [1].
The trophy pops when the mission completes [3].
Play the story mission Child's Play to completion [3].
It unlocks automatically as part of the story [2].
No gold-medal or optional objective is required — story missions have no medal requirement [1].
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen [3].
Play the story mission Headliners to completion [3].
It unlocks automatically as part of the story [2].
Follow the mission markers until the mission wraps up [3].
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen [3].
Play the story mission VCIA Takedown to completion [3].
It unlocks automatically as part of the story [2].
Bring a fast vehicle if the mission involves a chase — the guides note driving matters more than firepower here [1].
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen [3].
Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory to completion [3].
It unlocks automatically as part of the story [2].
Expect a heavy combat sequence — stock armour and a full weapon loadout first [1].
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen [3].
Finish the story first — the 100% Completion Checklist only appears under Progress > Stats after the credits [1].
Work the checklist, not the whole map: it is closer to 60% true completion, with most side quests not required [1].
Complete every robbery category in full: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs and 8 bank vaults [3].
Finish the collectible minimums: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos [3].
Hit the discovery minimums: 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 50 of 66 weapons, 100 of 255 animals studied [1].
Complete 70 of the 80 challenges — you may skip the 10 hardest [1].
Earn all 42 Shooting Range gold medals and finish all 42 drone time trials [3].
Finish all 15 of Bret's Target Deck hunts and 100 optional tasks [3].
Perform stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, drifts and airtime all feed the count [3].
The trophy needs 250 unique stunts, while the 100% checklist counts 300 of 397, so keep going past 250 [3].
Use the in-game stunt tracking to see which stunt types you have not done yet [1].
Mix vehicle types: bikes, cars and boats each open different stunt opportunities [3].

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.

steps.t: Try each of the nine activity types at least once [3].
Activities include racing, fishing, hunting, shooting ranges, drone races, arcade games, pool, mini golf and basketball [3].
You only need to try each one — winning or finishing is not required for this trophy [3].
Most types unlock naturally while you play the story and explore [1].

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

steps.t: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges [2].
The challenges are spread across the ranges — GameTrek counts 12 ranges in total [6].
All 42 golds are also required for the 100% checklist, so this is not optional work [3].
Replay a challenge as often as needed; medals are per-challenge and there is no time limit on retries [1].
Learn each challenge's scoring first with a practice run, then push for gold [3].

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

steps.t: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations [3].
All 42 drone time trials are also required for 100% completion, so practise the courses while you race [3].
Learn each course's racing line before pushing for the win [1].
Drone races unlock as you explore; check the map for unvisited Top Fun spots [3].
Win 20 different races across Leonida [3].
The 100% checklist asks for 30 of 40 unique races won, so 20 is only the first milestone [3].
Pick race types you are comfortable with first, then branch into the rest [1].
Race challenge gold medals are a separate count — 10 of 13 golds feed the checklist [3].

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps.t: Find Cal and take his fishing challenge [3].
Beat Cal's catch to win the challenge [3].
Fishing is one of the nine activity types, so it also feeds Master of None [3].
If you lose, retry the challenge — fishing challenges can be attempted again [1].
Find an arcade machine and complete any one arcade game [3].
The 100% checklist asks you to play all 4 video games, so try the others too while you are there [3].
Pick the shortest game first if you just want the trophy quickly [1].
Arcade games are one of the nine activity types for Master of None [3].

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.

steps.t: Play Andy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it [3].
Andy's strand is Lucia-only, so switch to Lucia to pick it up [5].
Quest givers tied to trophies return after the story, so this can be finished in post-story cleanup [5].
The strand also counts toward the eight strands needed for Strangers & Freaks [3].

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

steps.t: Play Kenton's mission strand to its final mission and complete it [3].
Kenton's strand ties into treasure hunting — the checklist needs 5 of his 7 treasure sets [3].
It can be finished after the story in free-roam [5].
The strand also counts toward the eight strands needed for Strangers & Freaks [3].

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.

steps.t: Play Billy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it [3].
Check the map for Billy's marker when it appears during or after the story [1].
It can be finished after the story in free-roam [5].
The strand also counts toward the eight strands needed for Strangers & Freaks [3].

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

steps.t: Complete eight qualifying Stranger mission strands across Leonida [3].
Strands include Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — each has its own final-mission trophy too [3].
Some strands are character-locked: Andy is Lucia-only, Tyrone and Bret are Jason-only [5].
Quest givers return after the story, so unfinished strands can be completed in free-roam [5].
These strands are not required for the 100% checklist, so they are usually what is left in stage 3 [1].

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.

steps.t: Play Randy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it [3].
Check the map for Randy's marker when it appears during or after the story [1].
It can be finished after the story in free-roam [5].
The strand also counts toward the eight strands needed for Strangers & Freaks [3].

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

steps.t: Play Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and complete it [3].
Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, so switch to Jason to pick it up [5].
It can be finished after the story in free-roam [5].
The strand also counts toward the eight strands needed for Strangers & Freaks [3].

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

steps.t: Meditate at all 18 required spots across Leonida [3].
Do the FIRST one in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept her invitation [3].
This is the only currently identified potentially missable trophy-related interaction — the balcony meditation is gone after Chapter 1 [1].
The last spot only opens once you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 [5].
Only 15 of the 18 count toward 100% completion, but the trophy needs all 18 [3].
Keep a manual save at the start and end of Chapter 1 as a safety net [1].

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

steps.t: Take Bret's hunting work and hunt a unique animal for him [3].
Bret's strand is Jason-only, so switch to Jason [5].
All 15 of Bret's Target Deck hunts are required for the 100% checklist [3].
Study animals through the binoculars first — 100 of 255 species count toward 100% [1].
Complete three full Collectible Card sets [3].
The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 card sets, so three is only the start [3].
Cards are found across Leonida — check shops, interiors and hidden spots as you explore [1].
Track your sets in Progress > Stats so you do not re-hunt cards you already own [1].
Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations across Leonida [3].
WAiNK also scans vehicles — the checklist needs 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned [1].
Scan every unfamiliar vehicle and landmark as you travel, from the start of the story [3].
The 100 WAiNK locations are also a checklist item, so this trophy comes free with 100% work [3].
Complete 50 challenges in total [2].
The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, and 100% completion needs 70 of them [5].
You may skip the hardest ones — only 70 of 80 are needed for the checklist [1].
Challenges span combat, driving, exploration and activities, so they fill in naturally during stage 2 [1].

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.desc: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

steps.t: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level [4].
Escape the police and lose the Wanted Level while your partner is still with you [3].
Use a fast car and break line of sight, then hide until the stars clear [1].
Do not let your partner get arrested or separated during the escape [3].

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

steps.t: Rob three shops consecutively with your partner, without clearing your Wanted Level between them [3].
Pick three shops close together so you can move fast from one to the next [1].
Keep your partner with you for all three robberies [3].
If the Wanted Level clears, the chain breaks — start the three again [3].
Discover 100 vehicles across Leonida [3].
Drive or scan every new vehicle you see with the WAiNK app [1].
The checklist needs 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so 100 is only halfway [1].
Check car parks, dealerships and traffic in different districts for models you have not seen [3].

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.t: Activate Combat Focus during a firefight with at least five enemies present [3].
Take down five enemies before the single Combat Focus activation ends [3].
Pick a busy shootout — gang operations give you plenty of targets [1].
If you run out of targets, retry in another fight; Combat Focus can be used again [1].

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

steps.t: Go to Vice City International Airport and steal a departing passenger aircraft [3].
Board the plane as it prepares to leave — timing matters, so watch the runway [3].
Take off and leave the airport airspace to register the unscheduled departure [3].
Expect a Wanted Level; lose it after you are clear [1].
Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat [3].
Tanks appear at military sites — approach with a plan, as the area is heavily guarded [1].
Once inside, use the tank's cannon in a fight to register the trophy [3].
Keep moving: the tank is tough but the wanted response is heavy [1].

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

steps.t: Pick a jewelry store and rob it without triggering detection [3].
Move quietly, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and get in and out clean [1].
Fencing jewelry counts toward the checklist too — $100,000 of jewelry fenced is required for 100% [3].
If you are spotted, leave and try another store — detection voids the attempt [3].
Successfully rob five bank vaults and escape after each one [3].
Bank vaults unlock in Chapter 4 through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… [3].
The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, so five is only part of the job [3].
Plan your escape route before you crack each vault [1].

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

steps.t: Find an armored truck on the road and rob it [3].
Stop the truck, take the cash, then escape the police response [3].
Armored trucks appear on regular routes — watch highways and commercial districts [1].
A fast getaway car parked nearby makes the escape much easier [1].
Explore all of Leonida and uncover the complete map [3].
Drive, fly and sail into every corner of the state — the map fills in as you visit [1].
Use the WAiNK app on landmarks as you go; it feeds both this trophy and You WAiNKer! [3].
Check the map for dark, unvisited patches and sweep them in stage 2 [1].

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

steps.t: Rob at least one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs [3].
The checklist needs all 39 gang operations, so one per gang is only the start [3].
Gang operations appear as you explore — check the map for their markers [1].
Track which gangs you have hit in Progress > Stats so none is missed [1].

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

steps.t: Go to a bar on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail overlooking the water [3].
The exact trigger is still being confirmed by the guide community — KeenGamer lists the method as unconfirmed [3].
Try sitting at an ocean-facing seat and ordering from the bar menu [3].
Do not rely on this method yet: check the Sources tab for updates before grinding it [4].

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

steps.t: Drive a vehicle out through a showroom — the trophy asks for a smash-out in classic style [3].
The exact method is still unconfirmed in the guides [3].
Try driving a car straight through the showroom glass from inside [3].
Do not rely on this method yet: check the Sources tab for updates before grinding it [4].

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

steps.t: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and steal the three key valuables there, then escape [3].
The exact valuables and escape trigger are still being pinned down by players [3].
Search the alley thoroughly before leaving — the valuables are the objective, not the bowling itself [3].
Treat this as unconfirmed until a second guide verifies the steps [4].
Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia [3].
Train Strength through workouts and physical activity with each character [3].
Switch characters to train the other one — both must reach the maximum [3].
Check each character's stats screen to confirm both are maxed [1].
Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile [3].
Everyday choices and crimes feed the profile — play normally and the count climbs [1].
Avoid the Irredeemable criminal profile: it is permanent and makes the police more aggressive [5].
Check your Criminal Profile in the stats menu to watch the count [1].
This is a hidden trophy whose unlock method is still unconfirmed [3].
The description hints at succeeding on a second try, but no guide has verified the trigger [3].
Do not grind blindly for it — wait for a verified method in the Sources tab [4].
It is one of the six trophies this guide honestly labels UNCONFIRMED [4].
This is a hidden trophy whose unlock method is still unconfirmed [3].
The description hints at witnessing something strange, but no guide has verified the trigger [3].
Do not grind blindly for it — wait for a verified method in the Sources tab [4].
It is one of the six trophies this guide honestly labels UNCONFIRMED [4].

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

steps.t: Perform a melee drive-by elimination — knock someone over from a moving vehicle with a melee attack [3].
The precise method is still being confirmed by the guide community [3].
Try it from a slow-moving car or bike against a pedestrian target [3].
Treat this as unconfirmed until a second guide verifies the steps [4].

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

steps.t: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts [3].
Marked bills come from robberies — fence them through contacts rather than spending them [3].
The same $250,000 is also a 100% checklist item, so it counts twice [3].
Track the total in Progress > Stats so you know how far along you are [1].
Spend a total of $100,000 across shops [3].
Clothes, weapons, food and vehicle upgrades all count toward the total [1].
Buy gear you actually need for the 100% grind and the total builds itself [1].
Expensive single purchases — vehicles and high-end weapons — move the counter fastest [3].
Purchase all eight purchasable garage properties [3].
Garages are bought through the in-game property listings — check the map for sale markers [1].
Save money for them during stage 2; robberies and fencing fund the purchases [3].
Each garage also gives you storage for the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good [3].

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps.t: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app [3].
Open the app, pick a vehicle you own or have found, and register it [3].
Any ten vehicles count — use the cheapest or most common ones first [1].
Registered vehicles also feed your vehicle discovery progress [1].
